positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed user experience for AI-driven real estate analysis application
- Developed features for web application (fundrise.com) investor experience to drive investor engagement on platform and increase investment/AUM
- Served as web project lead for feature development: collaborated with product, design, and other engineering teams to determine requirements, groom and scope tickets to capture level of effort, and resolve dependencies/impediments arising during development process, and acted as primary point of contact for all project stakeholders regarding web development and primary reviewer for all code changes and pull requests
- Migrated web application from JSP/AngularJS to Vue.js single page application to modernize tech stack and unlock performance and security improvements
- Upgraded web application to latest Vue.js version (3.4) to ensure long-term support and additional unlocks for application performance
- Updated entire web application in collaboration with design and product stakeholder to reflect company's rebranding
- Provided mentorship to junior engineers via recurring meetings and pull request code reviews
- Served as member of engineering onboarding committee to help new engineers acclimate to the Fundrise development environment

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Front End Software Engineer (July 2015 - December 2018)
- Team member on Capital One's new online customer servicing platform
- Developed a library of reusable UI components, including design of modal window, calendar date picker, and search and filter functionality, that are leveraged by multiple development teams and applications across the company
- Primary point of contact for questions and support regarding the component library
- Developed multiple standalone UI features for the application
- Implemented a refactored framework for logging customer activity that provided clearer, more accurate results for use by analysts and other interested parties
- Served as primary support contact as new framework was adopted by other teams on the application
- Collaborated with product, design, and other development teams to determine requirements and acceptance criteria for application features

Full Stack Software Engineer (July 2014 - July 2015)
- Worked on internal project related to big data storage and registration, using a Hadoop-based platform
- Responsible for application to register data sets
- Application included UI (HTML/JavaScript/AngularJS), API (Java, Spring), and database (MySQL, Hadoop) functionality

College Recruiting Associate (July 2014 - Present)
- Member of Carnegie Mellon campus recruiting team
- Attended career fairs and other recruiting events at CMU campus
- Served as contact for students going through recruiting process

positions.title: ISD Summer Associate
positions.description:
- Worked primarily with Microsoft SharePoint 2013.
- Created website prototypes on both the public and private-facing sides of SharePoint 2013, with a focus on dynamic content and content management systems.
- Developed a basic user guide to teach users about the basic processes and capabilities of SharePoint 2013.
